root_cause.text: The `tpm_dev_release()` function was not updated to use `kfree_sensitive()` when freeing the `chip->auth` structure, leaving sensitive cryptographic material (HMAC session keys, nonces, passphrase data) uncleared in freed slab memory, unlike all other code paths that free the same structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `kfree()` to `kfree_sensitive()` for `chip->auth` in `tpm_dev_release()`, and the commit message explicitly states that every other code path (e.g., `tpm2_end_auth_session()`, `tpm_buf_check_hmac_response()`) uses `kfree_sensitive()`, while this path was the only one using plain `kfree()`.
